steps.title: Integrate Offline AI Assistant Core
steps.description: Design an offline interactive AI terminal feature named HALO-9000 with system diagnostics, joke synthesizers, and intelligent terminal outputs.

steps.title: Modify XML Layout to Futuristic Cyber Theme
steps.description: Upgrade activity_main.xml layout with standard terminal styles, deep dark obsidian layouts, cyber green action widgets, and responsive scroll fields.

steps.title: Develop Quick Prompt Selection Chips
steps.description: Include premium horizontal buttons in activity_main.xml to execute custom pre-written smart prompts on one single tap.

steps.title: Implement Dynamic PCM Audio Synthesizers
steps.description: Write procedural keystroke and terminal-typing sound generator routines in MainActivity.java using standard Android AudioTrack APIs.

steps.title: Incorporate Rich Dialog Rendering Hooks
steps.description: Write dynamic code in MainActivity.java to render user and AI speech bubbles/blocks inside log views without static resource XML files.

steps.title: Configure Offline Query Response Matrix
steps.description: Build semantic rule-based replies in MainActivity.java to dynamically read Android system parameters, compile humorous jokes, and predict compiling results.

steps.title: Implement Asynchronous Character Typing Animators
steps.description: Develop smooth letter-by-letter rendering using Handler and runOnUiThread delays in MainActivity.java to simulate an active mainframe computing.

steps.title: Configure Automatic Down-Scrolling Routines
steps.description: Implement post-delayed ScrollView layout metrics logic in MainActivity.java to scroll to terminal bottom as characters are loaded.

steps.title: Validate System Manifest and Schema Namespaces
steps.description: Examine AndroidManifest.xml details to verify xmlns properties, app branding, activity declarations, and layout parameters.

steps.title: Building Hello App
steps.description: Invoke build engines to bundle, assemble, and optimize our updated offline AI terminal features.
